explication: Deep Learning Drizzle is a curated learning-resource catalog spanning courses, lectures, and related programs across AI topics. The principal workflow is to browse a topic on the catalog page and follow its course or lecture links. The Python script also turns the root README into an HTML page, using local templates and Markdown/emoji processing. The excerpts show the generator’s inputs and output, but not every topic section or the full link-handling logic.
